questions.question: Water and water vapour are in equilibrium in a closed vessel at 373 K. Why is this called a dynamic equilibrium, and what happens to the vapour pressure if some of the vapour is removed while the temperature is kept constant?
For the equilibrium N2O4(g) ⇌ 2NO2(g) at 298 K, Kc = 4.6 × 10^-3. Calculate Kp at this temperature and state the relation between Kp and Kc that you used. (R = 0.0831 L bar K^-1 mol^-1)

For 2NOCl(g) ⇌ 2NO(g) + Cl2(g), 2.0 mol of NOCl was placed in a one-litre flask, and the concentration of NO after equilibrium was established was found to be 0.4 mol L^-1. The equilibrium constant at 90 °C is x × 10^-4. Find x.
The equilibrium constant of a reaction at 300 K is 10. Calculate ΔG° for the reaction, and state the sign of ΔG° for a reaction whose equilibrium constant is less than 1. (R = 8.314 J K^-1 mol^-1)

For the exothermic reaction N2(g) + 3H2(g) ⇌ 2NH3(g), predict with reasons the effect on the equilibrium yield of NH3 of (a) increasing the pressure, (b) increasing the temperature, (c) adding a catalyst, and (d) adding argon at constant volume.
The ionisation constant of acetic acid is 1.8 × 10^-5. Calculate the degree of ionisation of acetic acid in its 0.05 M solution and the pH of the solution.

A solution is prepared by mixing 0.01 mol each of H2CO3, NaHCO3, Na2CO3 and NaOH in 100 mL of water. What is the pH of the resulting solution? (Given: pKa1 and pKa2 of H2CO3 are 6.37 and 10.32 respectively; log 2 = 0.30)

The pH of an aqueous solution containing 1 M benzoic acid (pKa = 4.20) and 1 M sodium benzoate is 4.5. What volume of the benzoic acid solution, in mL, is present in 300 mL of this buffer solution? (Given: log 2 = 0.3)
Equal volumes of 0.002 M BaCl2 and 0.0004 M Na2SO4 are mixed. Will BaSO4 precipitate? Compare the ionic product with the solubility product. (Ksp of BaSO4 = 1.1 × 10^-10)
The solubility product of AgCl is 1.8 × 10^-10 at 298 K. Calculate its molar solubility in pure water and in 0.1 M NaCl solution, and explain why the two values differ.
